name: Add an AI summary feature with the WordPress AI Client
query: Add a button in the editor sidebar that generates a two-sentence summary of the post using WordPress 7.0's AI features and saves it to post meta.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Guard with function_exists( 'wp_ai_client_prompt' ) and hide the UI when is_supported_for_text_generation() is false
Step 3: Expose the feature through a REST route whose permission_callback checks current_user_can( 'edit_post', $id ) (hand off to wp-rest-api)
Step 4: Run generation on explicit user action, not on save_post
Step 5: Handle WP_Error results, sanitize the output before saving, and register the meta with show_in_rest and auth_callback
Step 6: Leave provider and API key configuration to Settings > Connectors
success_criteria: No AI call happens on save_post or page load
Plugin does not ask for or store AI provider API keys
Model output is sanitized before storage and escaped on output
Feature degrades gracefully on WordPress < 7.0 or without a configured provider
Does not claim real-time collaboration support
